summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Andrey Anatolyevich Shumilin, a Russian former wrestler born March 9, 1970 in Kaliningrad, Russian SFSR. It states that he competed at the 1996 Summer Olympics and placed fourth in the super-heavyweight freestyle event.
one_line: Andrey Anatolyevich Shumilin is a former Russian wrestler who placed fourth in super-heavyweight freestyle at the 1996 Summer Olympics.
